name: Kikakuka Footprints
description: Footprints used by Kikakuka for couplers, variables, and string templates.
description_full: A KiCad footprint library for Kikakuka workflows. It provides the CouplerFixed, CouplerMoving, and CouplerOrigin footprints used by FreekiCAD assembly alignment, plus Variable and StringTemplate footprints used by the Fabrication Planner.
